title: Lake gauge census: candidate selection and candidate-to-binding review rules (pre-registered)
registeredBefore: any census request was sent (none was sent under LGC-2026-11-23 either); no level value of any candidate has been read

purposes.BINDING: unprofiled directory lakes (not in Lake's reviewed set): find gauge-grade level series (DIRECT_LAKE_GAUGE or DIRECT_OPERATOR_POOL) for the next binding batch
purposes.INDEPENDENT_TRUTH: every lake with a binding (reviewed or candidate): list series that are NOT the lake's bound live/fallback/history series, with independence evidence, so the operator-truth validation v3 can freeze a truth list from metadata alone

scope.lakes: all 621 directory lakes (brains/moon/runtime/knowledge/lakes-directory.json, the projection of Sources/SectorEngine/Support/LakeDirectory.swift)
scope.reviewedSet: jobs/brain_platform/sector_brain_platform/publisher_live/customer_lake_level_eligible.json lakeIds (Lake's REVIEWED set: 5 pilots + accepted_batch.json + accepted_batch2.json)
scope.boundSeries: brains/lake/runtime/LakeBrain/LakeSourceBindingsGenerated.swift (all rows, reviewed and candidate) plus the 5 hand-written pilots in LakeSourceBindings.swift
scope.readOnlyInputs: the census reads these files and never writes them; it records their sha256 in its output

notBeforeReason: the operator-truth validation (PR #243) runs 2026-11-24..30 on the Mac mini; 12 h margin after its window. Every networked path refuses before this instant (the guard is in the fetcher, so controls, geometry and census are all covered). The Mini request adds a second gate: only after #243 has posted its result on #51

excludedSources.SWOT: not gauge grade for sourceAuthority; SWOT-only lakes dilute the quality shares until decision R10
excludedSources.TVA host: www.tva.com is never queried (robots); USGS gauges at TVA reservoirs are the alternative
excludedSources.NWS NWPS / IEM HADS: redistributions of another agency's DCP; not queried, and never counted as independent truth
excludedSources.USGS 00065 gage height: a local-datum stage, not an elevation; out of scope for this census

cwms-data.usace.army.mil.terms: US Government public data, no key (https://cwms-data.usace.army.mil/cwms-data/)

storage.googleapis.com.terms: Sector's own public Lake Registry bucket (sector-lake-registry), USGS NHD derived

fetch.robots: robots.txt is read once per host (RFC 9309): 2xx parsed; 401/403 disallow all; other 4xx allow all; 5xx, a redirect or no answer disallow all. A disallowed path is never requested and is recorded ROBOTS_DISALLOWED per host and path
fetch.values: metadata only. The one data call (USGS instantaneous values, last 12 h) is made only for USGS POOL candidates of BINDING lakes that pass S1-S3 and S6 (the pre-shortlist); it keeps time stamps and drops every value at parse time. Liveness of every other row comes from catalog extents
fetch.redirects: never followed; a 3xx answer is recorded and treated as a failed request
fetch.retries: at most 2 retries (429, 5xx, network error); every attempt counts against maxRequests and is logged
fetch.partialOutput: a failed request, chunk or lake is recorded under errors (by stage) and the run continues; when the budget is exhausted the run stops discovery, finalizes what it has and sets summary.budgetExhausted

parameters.00062: reservoir surface elevation above a datum

cwms.parameter: Elev (base parameter); sub-parameters Pool / Forebay / Headwater count as pool, Tailwater never

classes.POOL: a pool/lake series inside the outline (or within R1) with no tailwater or river cue
classes.TAILWATER: a tailwater/outflow series, or a dam-cue station outside the outline
classes.RIVER: a river/creek station outside the outline with no pool cue
classes.RULE_CURVE: a guide/rule/plan/forecast series (the 2026-11-21 trap), any series whose latest time is in the future; never a level source
classes.UNKNOWN: cues conflict or are absent (including a CWMS sub-location Upper/Lower); hand review

classification.ruleCurveApplies: to a CWMS version and sub-parameter and to a RISE item title, never to a station or lake name
classification.futureLatest: a latest time more than futureLatestToleranceHours after the census time is a rule/plan series: class RULE_CURVE, never live

selection.note: Stage A, metadata only. Decides which candidates go to the stage B binding review. Applies to purpose BINDING.
selection.S1_provider: provider has an Engine adapter: usgs (62614/62615/00062), cwms, rise
selection.S2_class: classification POOL; UNKNOWN goes to HAND_REVIEW; TAILWATER, RIVER, RULE_CURVE are rejected

S3_position.pointOnlyVerdict: HAND_REVIEW (no outline: R1 cannot be evaluated)

selection.S5_datum: a vertical datum is named by the parameter, the site or the location; missing datum -> HAND_REVIEW
selection.S6_host: robots allows the path and the host terms are listed in hosts
selection.S7_unique: the station is not bound by another REVIEWED lake, and no other directory lake has the station inside or nearer its outline
selection.S9_order: per lake: DIRECT_OPERATOR_POOL before DIRECT_LAKE_GAUGE, then inside before outside, then nearer, then longer record (begin date)

independence.note: Applies to purpose INDEPENDENT_TRUTH. Evidence from metadata only; each candidate is compared with every bound live, fallback and history series of the same lake.
independence.boundSeriesExcluded: a candidate equal to a bound series (same provider family and series; Access2Water and CWMS are one family when the time-series id matches) is not listed as a candidate
independence.originAgency: usgs -> USGS; rise -> USBR; cwms/a2w -> USGS_COPY when the version names USGS, NWS_REDISTRIBUTION when it names NWS/NWPS/HADS, otherwise USACE_UNLABELLED (origin unknown: USACE districts publish USGS-operated gauges under their own version names; SHEF is a transfer format, not an origin); tva -> TVA; nwps/hads -> NWS_REDISTRIBUTION

tiers.NOT_INDEPENDENT: same USGS site id as a bound series; or same CWMS location id as a bound cwms/a2w series; or a CWMS USGS copy when the lake has a bound USGS series; or an NWS redistribution; or same origin agency within sameGaugeDistanceM
tiers.INDEPENDENT_AGENCY: origin agency differs from every bound series' origin (USACE_UNLABELLED counts as possibly USGS), the site id differs, and every bound gauge has known coordinates at least sameGaugeDistanceM away
tiers.INDEPENDENT_SITE: same origin agency as a bound series but a different site id at least otherSiteMinDistanceM from every bound gauge with known coordinates
tiers.UNCERTAIN: anything else, including a USGS/USACE_UNLABELLED pair, a bound gauge whose location is unknown (TVA, NWS) and a CWMS USGS copy whose USGS site is not identifiable

independence.eligibleForV3: INDEPENDENT_AGENCY or INDEPENDENT_SITE, classification POOL, position inside or within S3, live by S4 from catalog extents; v3 freezes its own list from these rows under its own pre-registration
independence.usgsUsaceBorder: any pair with USACE_UNLABELLED on one side and USGS or USGS_COPY on the other is UNCERTAIN, never INDEPENDENT_AGENCY. Only explicit evidence makes such a CWMS series USACE-operated: an entry in an origin-evidence file (--origin-evidence; provider, series, origin USACE, the evidence text, e.g. a USACE sensor id or a documented non-USGS DCP) written by the v3 pre-registration or the owner. No such file exists at registration
independence.boundCoordinates: USGS sites from the site service; CWMS/Access2Water from the office location catalog; RISE items from the fetched RISE locations (item -> location); TVA and NWS stay unknown
independence.structuralCap: a bound lake whose binding includes a gauge with unknown coordinates (TVA, NWPS, HADS) can never get an INDEPENDENT_* row; computed from the committed bindings at registration: 130 of 298 bound lakes (129 of 294 reviewed) can; the USGS/USACE border rule lowers the reachable number further for lakes bound to unlabelled CWMS series. The census reports the live figure

bindingReview.note: Stage B, run only after the census and after PR #243 has run. Uses level values. Same rules as batches 1-2 (binding-review-v1 R1-R9, the 2026-11-21 dry-run checks (b)-(d), the runner's 15 ft history/live rule). Not changeable after the census output exists.
bindingReview.R1_position: gauge <= 1.5 km of the outline (point-only lakes: hand review)
bindingReview.R2_identity: name similarity >= 0.5, or the gauge is inside the outline
bindingReview.R3_notTrap: no tailwater, river or well gauge; no guide/rule curve series
bindingReview.R4_state: the gauge's state is one of the lake's states
bindingReview.R5_unique: no better-matching lake claims the gauge; not bound by another reviewed lake
bindingReview.R6_live: last reading < 72 h old (daily feeds < 192 h)
bindingReview.R7_level: 30-day median within -25..+8 ft of the directory full pool; a lake with no full pool: n-a, then check (d) n-a and hand review
bindingReview.R8_datum: the vertical datum is identified and the same for live, fallback and history (or a recorded offset)
bindingReview.R9_second: an independent second origin agrees within 2 ft; n-a when none exists. The same gauge through another endpoint never counts (batch 2 rule)
bindingReview.check_b: primary vs fallback within 0.5 ft; any FAIL is held
bindingReview.check_c: live within 5 ft of the 7-day median
bindingReview.check_d: guide curve / operating zone / full pool within 25 ft of live
bindingReview.historyLive: seeded history 365-day median within 15 ft of live (historyLiveMismatch)
bindingReview.adapter: the provider has an Engine adapter; otherwise the lake moves to new-provider work, not to the batch
bindingReview.decision: every rule PASS or n-a and every check PASS -> proposed for the batch; any FAIL -> held with its reason; a FLAG -> hand review by the owner
bindingReview.noRelaxation: the target (>= 311 reviewed lakes, 50%) is never a reason to change a rule, threshold or classification after values are seen; report the count that passes

coverageArithmetic.ceilingBasis: the reviewed count read from customer_lake_level_eligible.json at run time (not this constant) plus the BINDING lakes with a SHORTLIST row

publication.output: local files in --out only (census.json, census.summary.json, robots.json, request log); registered in the Lake research folder's manifest on the Mac mini

supersedes.why: review of PR #247 (2026-11-23) before any request was sent: date guard on every networked path, CWMS origin across the USGS/USACE border, rule-curve and future-time cues, robots/redirect/retry handling, partial output

controls.lakes: Allegheny Reservoir|PA (USGS 03012520 62615; CWMS Kinzua-Lake.Elev.Inst.1Hour.0.RESOPS), Bluestone Lake|WV (USGS 03179800 62614; CWMS Bluestone-Lake.Elev.Inst.15Minutes.0.OBS), Alcova Reservoir|WY (RISE 114)
controls.pass: every control series of the provider is rediscovered with class POOL; otherwise the provider is disabled for the run
